summary: Headline point and estimate figures recompute from quarantine/orders.csv and match the metrics registry. R04 names the Welch AOV effect as a proportion difference although the recomputed effect is Cohen's d 0.4869 on a 23.37 EUR mean gap. CLM-AOV caveats omit delivered-only and net of refunds. CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV population text describes the all-orders frame used by the completion test.
